headline: Profit rebounds from impairment, adjusted margins soften
summary_short: Ashland's Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) net income was $16M ($0.35 diluted EPS), swinging from a $742M loss a year ago that included a $706M goodwill impairment; sales rose 7.3% y/y to $497M, while Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) of $109M fell $4M y/y on higher production costs and SG&A.
summary_long: GAAP results were flattered by the absence of last year's $706M goodwill impairment ($375M Life Sciences, $331M Specialty Additives) and $754M of pre-tax key items; net income was $16M versus a $742M loss. Sales rose $34M y/y on higher volume, favorable FX and price/mix. Cost of sales fell $4M on lower operating costs and favorable price/mix, lifting gross margin 5.7 points to 34.2%. Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) was $109M, down $4M y/y, as unfavorable production costs and higher SG&A outweighed the volume/price/FX gains. Cash rose to $440M q/q; long-term debt held flat at $1,374M; equity was $1,870M. FY2026 sales ($1,835-$1,870M) and Adjusted EBITDA ($385-$400M) guidance reaffirmed; adjusted EPS growth outlook cut to low-to-mid-single-digit from mid-to-high-single-digit growth on a higher tax rate.
